rationale: The common selector_header renders identity and view controls as siblings, with Rendered checked initially; CSS pushes controls to the right and hides only the direct body/source children of the selected enclosing group. A nested Facts radio therefore cannot switch its surrounding Lean block. Structured render_unit keeps its shield and Draft status in the header, and suppresses a source selector when a draft has no citation. Legacy markdown_heading moves only leading identifying anchors; tests verify later anchors remain in the body, IDs appear once, and prose markup survives. Rust and test selections are both present in the alternate Rust view. This supports the structural presentation contract, subject to browser support for the stylesheet selectors.
